title: 3. Separate useful grasp preload from harmful reactive compression
hypothesis: A constant capture-curl preload preserves axial traction without the destabilizing observation-dependent tightening that makes the original controller drop the pen.

prediction.against: Frozen R-046 with the exact R-068 zero-curl substitution
prediction.rationale: A +0.10 fresh sustained-success gain would recover a meaningful fraction of the clamp's slow-spin failures; unlike R-069's intervention timing and R-070's synchronous unloading, this isolates static preload from reactive compression.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r073_constant_preload --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r073_constant_preload"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/constant_preload.py registered as --study r073_constant_preload in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. Parent config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent (hashes checked), no fitting, parameters unchanged.

Preload constant, frozen to disk with provenance before any episode: the median of the parent's extra_curl over all recorded in-play steps of its archived R-068 fresh and promotion runs where extra_curl > 1e-6, with extra_curl = capture_curl * ((1 - contact) + 0.75 (1 - retained)) recomputed offline from the archived observations using the parent's own gates; the study exits if no positive step exists. No scalar search.

Arms: parent; zero_curl (the exact R-068 substitution, an experimental control that did not pass D-052 promotion); constant_preload (one audited line: extra_curl = C + 0.0 * self.capture_curl * (...)). Identity form (C = 0, factor 1.0) gated bit for bit offline on D-050's archived parent observations before any episode.

One frozen 200-case Stage-3 manifest on seed 4631 at config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r073_block_s4631.yaml (cases 0-9 unused, promotion 10-39, fresh 40-199), placement-disjoint from every committed pen-spin manifest. Each arm runs each panel in its own fresh process: six processes, 570 evaluated episodes, zero LLM calls.

Primary: constant_preload minus zero_curl fresh sustained success (160 pairs), 95% t interval; prediction at least +0.10; supported if the mean is at least +0.10 and the lower bound is above zero; refuted if the upper bound is below +0.10; otherwise inconclusive. Secondary: constant_preload minus parent and zero_curl minus parent on both panels. Repair qualification: strict paired promotion against both controls on the 30 promotion cases, fresh lower bound above zero against both, and no observed drop increase against either control on either panel; an established drop increase disqualifies.

Reported per panel and arm: sustained success, paired success and drop differences with intervals and win/loss/tie, failure split (drops, off-centre, slow spin), in-play mean |spin|, drive and per-axis executed-action saturation over recorded in-play steps. bc_steps 0, no imitation, no LLM repair, held-out split untouched.

falsified_by: The fresh paired interval's upper bound is below +0.10; increased drops would separately disqualify the candidate for repair even if success improved.

preload.rule: median of parent extra_curl over archived in-play steps with extra_curl > 1e-06

controls.parent: the unchanged frozen R-046 learner, each panel in its own process
controls.zero_curl: the exact R-068 clamp, each panel in its own process (an experimental control; replicates D-052 on new cases)
controls.preload: constant 0.2266 = median of the parent's extra_curl over 59,315 archived R-068 in-play steps (all positive; quartiles 0.177 / 0.227 / 0.603, mean 0.334, capture_curl 0.398), frozen with archive hashes before any episode
controls.identity_gate: the preload form at C = 0, factor 1.0 reproduced the parent's actions bit for bit on all 23,484 archived D-050 observations

notes: Primary, predeclared (160 fresh pairs): constant preload minus zero-curl clamp +0.0000 [-0.086, +0.086] (45/160 vs 45/160; 24 wins, 24 losses, 112 ties); the upper bound is below +0.10: refuted. The preload doubles the drops of the clamp (20 vs 10; +0.0625 [+0.017, +0.108] per case) and has more off-centre failures (15 vs 8), fewer slow-spin failures (80 vs 97) and higher spin (5.75 vs 4.30 rad/s): static compression buys back spin rate at the price of retention, and the two cancel exactly on success. Promotion panel: preload 2/30 vs clamp 6/30 (-0.1333 [-0.295, +0.029]). No arm qualifies as a repair parent.

Replication of D-052 on new cases (secondary): zero-curl minus parent on this fresh panel +0.0688 [-0.024, +0.162] (45 vs 34; 34 wins, 23 losses), drops 10 vs 26 (-0.1000 [-0.150, -0.050], established), off-centre 8 vs 43; promotion 6/30 vs 6/30 (tie). The drop and off-centre reductions replicate at the same size; the success gain is smaller than R-068's +0.15 and its interval includes zero here. Pooled over the R-068 and R-073 fresh panels (320 pairs, not predeclared): 97 vs 62 successes, +0.109; drops 17 vs 47.

Constant preload minus parent on fresh: +0.0688 [+0.001, +0.137] (45 vs 34), drops 20 vs 26; the preload keeps part of the parent's spin (5.75 vs 5.63 rad/s) and part of the clamp's retention, and ends between them on drops and off-centre failures.

Reading: the parent's capture curl has a useful static component (the preload recovers spin rate: slow-spin failures 80 vs 97) and a harmful reactive component (the preload still drops the pen twice as often as the clamp, though less than the parent). At the median level the two effects cancel on success; a lower constant might trade differently, but no other level was run (predeclared limitation: one frozen constant).
Saturation: drive above 0.99 on 92-98% of recorded in-play steps in every arm; executed-action saturation 4-7% of components.

Accounting: 570 Isaac episodes in six fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 6 min wall time. Deviations: none; protocol.seeds was emptied mechanically after approval because the committed manifest carries seed 4631. Final-test split untouched.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted that a frozen constant preload (0.2266, the median of the parent's own extra_curl over 59,315 archived in-play steps) would beat the exact zero-curl clamp by at least +0.10 fresh sustained success; observed 0.000 [-0.086, +0.086] on 160 pairs (45 vs 45; 24 wins, 24 losses), upper bound below +0.10, the predeclared refutation. The mechanism split is visible: the preload recovers spin rate (5.75 vs 4.30 rad/s; slow-spin failures 80 vs 97) but doubles the clamp's drops (20 vs 10, +0.063 [+0.016, +0.109]) and off-centre failures (15 vs 8), so static compression trades retention for spin one for one at this level. No arm qualifies as a repair parent (promotion: preload 2/30, clamp 6/30, parent 6/30). Secondary: the clamp's advantage over the parent replicated on new cases in drops (10 vs 26) and off-centre failures (8 vs 43) at the same size, with a smaller success gain (+0.069 [-0.024, +0.162], 45 vs 34); pooled with R-068 the clamp is 97 vs 62 of 320 with 17 vs 47 drops. Confidence 0.9: exact identity gate, frozen constant, 160 pairs; the only open end is other preload levels.
verdicts.next_experiment: Do not spend more episodes on preload levels: the clamp's retention gain and the preload's spin gain are the same lever pulled in opposite directions. The way to raise spin on the zero-curl operating point without reintroducing compression is the stroke itself (deferred R-064 timing feedback, R-070 stroke-synchronous unloading); the zero-curl clamp is the parent for those, qualified by its replicated drop reduction and a pooled +0.109 over 320 fresh pairs even though it missed the strict 30-case rule by 0.006 and tied the parent on this block's promotion panel.

verdicts.reasoning: The predicted paired_success_difference increase of at least +0.10 versus the exact zero-curl control is refuted: the fresh estimate was 0.0000 with 95% interval [-0.08579, +0.08579], whose upper bound is below the predeclared threshold [logs/pen_spin/r073_constant_preload/summary.json]. Both arms achieved 45/160 successes, so the tie provides no evidence of improvement [logs/pen_spin/r073_constant_preload/summary.json]. Constant preload also established a fresh drop increase against zero-curl: 20 versus 10 drops, paired difference +0.0625 [0.01721, 0.10779], independently disqualifying it for repair [logs/pen_spin/r073_constant_preload/summary.json]. It failed strict promotion against both controls; this result rejects the tested frozen preload, not every possible constant preload or a uniquely identified compression mechanism [logs/pen_spin/r073_constant_preload/summary.json].

advisor.reasoning: Replacing reactive compression with a frozen preload is a structural intervention distinct from exhausted scalar tuning, deferred intervention timing, and synchronous unloading. Its 570 episodes and zero LLM calls on free seed 4631 purchase both diagnostic controls and an independent promotion opportunity, without treating the unqualified clamp as a repair parent. The weakest point is that the archived positive-curl median may itself overcompress the grasp, but freezing it without a search makes that risk directly testable. The paired_success_difference prediction is falsified if its fresh interval's upper bound is below +0.10 against the exact zero-curl control; increased drops independently disqualify repair use, and strict promotion against both controls remains mandatory.

The preload constant is the median of the parent's extra_curl over all recorded in-play steps of its R-068 fresh and promotion runs where extra_curl exceeds 1e-6 (extra_curl = capture_curl * ((1 - contact) + 0.75 (1 - retained)) recomputed offline from the archived observations with the parent's own gates), frozen to disk with its provenance before any episode; the study exits if no positive step exists. The substitution is one audited line, extra_curl = C + 0.0 * capture_curl * (...), with the identity form (C = 0, factor 1.0) gated bit for bit offline on D-050's archived observations like R-065/R-068. Repair qualification: strict promotion against both controls on the 30 promotion cases, fresh lower bound above zero against both, no observed drop increase against either on either panel.
